title: Übel Blatt
native: Übel Blatt～ユーベルブラット～
synopsis:
Rumors stir throughout the land: when the wielder of the black sword draws his dark blade, all who stand in its path are torn asunder…!

Köinzell, the mysterious young boy who carries the black sword, undeniably wields it with exceptional skill, but can he truly be responsible for the bloody rumors?
Pursued by the Traitorous Lances, four powerful warriors who were thought to have been defeated by the Seven Heroes, the strength of the young swordsman will be tested to its limit. At battle’s end, only the shocking truth of Köinzell’s quest will stand above the corpses of his enemies…

An epic fantasy on the grandest of scales!

(Source: Yen Press)

episodes.title: Durch Bruch (Break Through)
episodes.synopsis:
Blatt Meister Ascheriit was slain by his allies and was branded a traitor. Now, 20 years later, he is back with a new name, Köinzell, and a thirst for vengeance. Köinzell arrives at the border wall, Thousand Stonespears, at the Border City of Rielde-Velem. Here, he sets about infiltrating an underground monastery of corrupt monks.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Unter Morgen Monde (Under the Morning Moons)
episodes.synopsis:
During a deadly exchange against Rangzatz, Köinzell is thrust down to the depths of the underground monastery. However, Köinzell had visited this fortress with Ergnach in the past. And now, as Köinzell fends off the elite warrior monks, he releases the magic circle spell his comrade had once sacrificed his life to conjure.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Langer Regen (The Long Rain)
episodes.synopsis:
When Köinzell reaches the Seven Heroes' encampment, he is forced to confront the immense power and glory his former comrades have amassed since they murdered him in cold blood. Despondent, Köinzell is standing in the rain when a masked avenger makes an attempt on his life.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Köinzell
episodes.synopsis:
Chiliarch Fargo invites Wied and Aht to the mayor's manor at night. That night, the two are met by a horde of undead bandits risen through dark Wischtechian magic. Simultaneously, Fargo launches a brutal assault on the refugees, including Peepi. Under the moonlit sky, Köinzell unleashes the power of his Black Sword.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Die Burg vom Helden (The Castle of the Hero)
episodes.synopsis:
Schtemwölech welcomes Köinzell's assault with a powerful blast from Dragon's Maw, a Wischtechian magic artillery. Köinzell diverts its attack and breaches the castle's defenses. Inside, Geranpen is faced with the ultimate choice: either remain loyal to his Lord or seek out the truth.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Schtemwölech
episodes.synopsis:
In the depths of the castle altar, Schtemwölech had been conducting vile experiments on demihuman girls. By infusing fairy blood to his, the landgrave had attained a physique of steel through a Wischtechian ritual. Now, Köinzell must confront this former friend to put an end to his twisted plan.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Der leere Sarg (The Empty Coffin)
episodes.synopsis:
A state funeral is held to pay tribute to Schtemwölech's glorious rule. Peepi and Altea reconvene with Köinzell, who had taken shelter in the mountains. As the company watches the funeral procession lay the landgrave's coffin to rest at the sacred burial site, Köinzell vows vengeance against the six remaining heroes.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Der Heldmörder (The Hero-Killer)
episodes.synopsis:
In a fit of paranoia, the deranged Batterygrave Barestar commands his men to search for the Hero-Killer in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, where Köinzell sought shelter. Meanwhile, under Glenn's leadership, Elsaria's company hunts for the treacherous rebel.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Junge Blätter (Young Leaf)
episodes.synopsis:
At the Hall of Swords, Glenn entrusts a manhunt mission to Ichfeis, a slave knight vying to restore the title Blatt Meister. Meanwhile, in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, Köinzell's fight against Elsaria and company takes a desperate turn. Eager to prove herself, Aht recklessly charges in, only to sustain an injury.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Gegenangriff (Counterattack)
episodes.synopsis:
Köinzell's stand against the batterygrave's military inspires the townsfolk of Jullas-Abllas to take up arms. Their bravery even convinces Elsaria, the Elector's daughter, to side with the Free City. Just as the tides are about to turn in Köinzell's favor, a powerful blast from a magic artillery cuts through the sky.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Gefühl zu… (With Feeling)
episodes.synopsis:
As Barestar's Floating Castle and magic artillery wreak havoc on all, the people recognize Köinzell's stand to protect the city and call him for what he is, a hero. Meanwhile, Elsaria and company thwart Barestar's men from snatching Marquis Glenn's latest Flagship of the Dragon Airship Fleet, and launch a counteroffensive.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Neues Schwert (New Sword)
episodes.synopsis:
Ichfeis, a slave knight who seeks to earn his freedom, faces Köinzell the Hero-Killer in a fated duel. As they cross blades, Ichfeis coaxes Köinzell to launch the Black Wing, the crowning technique of Ludift-style swordsmanship, and delivers his own imperfect rendition. Köinzell strikes back with a magnificent assault

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)
